milestone: CPU tensor element and shape inference
implementation: Frontend-only extension: infer unannotated tensor leaves independently in source order, require completed homogeneous CPU numeric scalars, preserve contextual construction, and publish the existing TensorLiteral IR. No backend, scheduler, storage or arithmetic implementation changes.

contract.defaults: Whole-number scalar expressions default to int64, decimal/exponent expressions to float64, under existing scalar rules.
contract.types: All six implemented CPU numeric identities; no implicit conversion or common-type promotion between elements.
contract.shapes: Rectangular nested literals, rank-zero scalar data and flat literal data with explicit constant dimensions.
contract.context: Explicit Tensor element context continues to type numeric literals; already typed values must conform exactly.
contract.empty: Empty data requires an expected Tensor element type; dimensions alone do not determine it.
contract.evaluation: Each leaf is checked and evaluated once in source order; first runtime failure stops construction; no partial value is published.
contract.ownership: Existing checked allocation, retained immutable tensor results and cached worker outcomes.
contract.limits: Existing nesting, source/value/element limits, shape/index/byte checks and numeric target capabilities remain active.

qualification.scope: Focused inference, frontend, source/worker, numeric frontend, storage and Metal regressions; not the full 355-test suite.
coverage: Default int64/float64 identity, exact limits, signed zero/subnormal/max-finite float64 values, scalar/rank-two/explicit shapes.
Six numeric identities from typed scalar bindings/conversions; contextual float32 and mixed-literal float64 construction.
Inferred function results and dynamic conditional shape joins; nested workers with typed tensor captures and cached results.
1/2/4-worker success, cancellation, deadlines, admission rejection, and allocation injection positions 1-8.
Retained tensor data checked after invocation/task cleanup; no partial result after allocation failures.
Inferred tensor leaves fail in source order with original ArithmeticFault locations and settled allocations.
Mixed numeric identities rejected in either order; empty, ragged, Boolean, tensor/task/error leaves rejected.
Shape overflow/count checks, element budgets, diagnostic source positions and preserved executable on invalid compilation.
Debug, optimized, ASan/UBSan and separate TSan generated/runtime variants; sanitized frontend suite.

remaining_gates: General immutable arrays and higher-order operations
Records, other general values and modules
Native library packaging and editor tooling
Native distributed design discussion before implementation
